serialization.notes: All six methods restore identical predictions from deterministic inference payloads. Payload format includes method, dimensions, all field names, dtypes, shapes, metadata, task IDs and raw tensor bytes. Resume bytes use torch.save with optimizer state.

metric_replay.notes: All MSE, payload-byte, example/update, and active-compute fields replayed exactly. Non-deterministic wall-clock and throughput columns were excluded from exact replay.
